items.reason: Only the Jamii directory profile and the 2 short lines about the branch (partner brands Nike, adidas, Asics, Puma; premier sporting goods destination) were found. Schools directory pages only: public primary, Quintile 5 fee-paying, and general admissions and uniform boilerplate. No school-specific programmes or history to support 100 words without padding.
The Fresha page is a generic salon directory; its services and reviews belong to other venues. The Constantia Valley and my-catalogue pages did not return usable store content for this branch.
School register page gives only identifiers, learner and teacher numbers, quintile and fee status. No programmes, history or facilities could be sourced to make 100 real words.

Only africabz and sayellow directory entries for Engen False Bay 1 Stop (N2, Macassar) were found, with one review mentioning Woolies food. Chain-level Woolworths facts alone are not allowed, and no branch-specific content was found.
Eat Out and Yep pages returned only site navigation and news headlines. The directory sources were blocked by anti-bot checks. Nothing about the restaurant itself was found.

Only the africabz directory entry (address, categories, hours) and user reviews were usable. Tripadvisor was blocked and the business website 1890housesushi.co.za was not fetched. Review quotes alone do not make an honest 100-word description.
The business website timed out, and the only other sources were generic Western Cape accommodation directory pages. Nothing specific to this property was found.
HotelPlanner page gives only star rating, check-in and check-out times, room types and generic booking-site text. Not enough property-specific content for 100 real words.

Only the Waterstone Village mall directory and trading hours were found. The shop listing for Bargain Books at Shop 28 contains only the name and phone number, and the chain-wide and mall-level facts alone are not allowed.

Bootlegger pages are about the chain (120-plus cafes, menus, app). The XS Salt River branch itself was not found; the ourcafes page timed out and TripAdvisor was blocked. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.
The business website timed out. The only page was an Eat Out news page with site navigation and headlines, with no content about the restaurant.

The business's own site (capecarepharm.co.za) failed to resolve (DNS error) and there are no search results at all. The only page in the research file is a Medpages listing giving an address and phone number only, with generic Medpages-platform boilerplate; no hours, services, delivery or SAPC-registration fact is verifiable.
The business website timed out. Search results were unrelated Cape Town and outdoor-retail pages, with no lodge-specific content.
Sources were a Tanzanian jobs and tenders site (mabumbe.com) and TVET college news about Gauteng, not the Thornton campus. The college's own site returned 404. Nothing about this campus was found.
The only source was an Eat Out news page with site navigation and headlines. The business website was not in the research and no restaurant-specific content was found.

Only an Inside Guide article about Ellerman House restaurants was found. It covers OneEighty and Curate together, and the Ellerman House site was not fetched, so a Curate-only description would be unsupported.

The business's own site (dekelderrestaurant.com) timed out and was never actually fetched; the only page in the research file is an Eat Out news/navigation page with no venue content at all. No dishes, wine list, event-package detail or any other De Kelder-specific fact is verifiable in the crawled data, so 100 real words cannot be sourced.

The africabz listing gives real hours and review content, but its address (13 Newport St, Gardens) does not match the supplied address (91 Kloof Nek Road, Tamboerskloof) - a possible wrong-branch or data-conflict concern that needs checking before publishing. The own site dinkelbakery.co.za was not fetched, so review quotes and an unverified address are not enough for an honest description.
The business domain eccoilcaffe.co.za now shows a parked page registered by an unrelated IT company (InterDev Systems). No cafe content exists to research.

No page was actually fetched for this business: eatout.co.za, tripadvisor.com and hacienda.co.za all timed out or were blocked, so the research file holds zero pages. The only search results returned are unrelated legal articles about constitutional 'entrenchment', with nothing about the restaurant. Nothing verifiable exists in this chunk's source data.

Only a Yellosa directory entry for Identity at Golden Acre Shopping Centre (unverified listing, company description only) and a broken store-site fetch were found. No branch-specific facts beyond that.

The Facebook page confirms only the category (a Chinese and sushi buffet and takeaway restaurant) and one operational post about staying open during load shedding; Dining Out was blocked and search results add nothing else. That is real but too thin to carry an honest 100-word description without inventing dishes or history, so it stays deferred.

The only page found was an online casino affiliate site (jamaicamecrazy.co.za) with casino bonuses and games. It is not a restaurant, so the listing's category or address looks wrong and should be checked before any description is written.
Dining Out was blocked by anti-bot checks, joefish.net timed out, and the search results were unrelated YouTube and Zhihu pages. Nothing about the restaurant was found.

Only the africabz directory entry and user reviews (a wide selection, strong children's section on nature and science, seating for browsers) were found. The shop's own site kalkbaybooks.co.za was not fetched, so 100 real words cannot be sourced.

The KLuK CGDT contact page gives addresses, phone lines and departments (boutique, property, marketing). It has no description of the boutique's product, history or services, so 100 real words cannot be sourced.

The Point Mall page was only captured up to other merchants' hours and menus (Kauai, NV-80 Grill, Poke Co, SCHOON Bakery); the crawled text is truncated before it reaches La Frontiere & Zimborders' own entry, so neither the supplied business-consulting description nor a border-terminal-management framing can be confirmed from this chunk's data. Category mismatch is a real concern and should be checked before publishing either version.

Only one April 2025 Crush magazine interview was usable (smash burgers, pickles, sauce and buns made from scratch, a chicken smash burger, launched weeks earlier). That is not enough for 100 real words without padding, and the business website was not in the research.
Only a BikeFinder page was found: motorcycle key cutting, repairs to bike locks and an after-hours call-out. The business website did not resolve, so 80 or so words are supported and not 100.

The only page actually fetched is a generic Cylex directory advertisement for Cylex's own listing products, with no Matrix Warehouse content at all; the Ysterplaat branch could not be independently confirmed as a current, active Matrix Warehouse store from any source in this chunk's research data. Possible wrong-branch or closed-branch concern: hold until the Ysterplaat branch itself can be verified.

The Mediclinic page was mostly cookie consent text. The only facts were a meta description: a 400-bed multi-disciplinary acute care hospital in Panorama, plus generic navigation. That is not enough for 100 real words.

The Farm Village page is a short product blurb: locally grown organic greens and vegetables, seasonal fruit and mushrooms sourced in, a farm on Sleepy Hollow Lane practising no-dig farming. About 75 words of real content, with no further sources.

The firm's own site (mlvlaw.co.za) timed out and its Facebook page returned no usable text; the only search results are unrelated (post office listings). No practice-area, history or branch-specific fact for this firm is verifiable anywhere in the crawled data.
